subject: Important Update: New Payment Options Available
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to inform you that we have introduced new payment options to make your shopping experience even more convenient. You can now pay using credit cards, PayPal, or bank transfer. We understand the importance of providing flexible payment methods, and we hope this update enhances your shopping experience with us. If you have any questions or need assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out to our customer support team. Thank you for choosing us for your shopping needs!
